xsql:
SELECT 
    -- RANK 1
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN name END), '') AS mix_1_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_1_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_1_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_1_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_1_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_1_others_pct,

    -- RANK 2
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN name END), '') AS mix_2_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_2_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_2_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_2_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_2_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_2_others_pct,

    -- RANK 3
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN name END), '') AS mix_3_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_3_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_3_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_3_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_3_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_3_others_pct,

    -- RANK 4
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN name END), '') AS mix_4_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_4_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_4_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_4_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_4_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_4_others_pct,

    -- RANK 5
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN name END), '') AS mix_5_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_5_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_5_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_5_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_5_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_5_others_pct,

    -- RANK 6
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN name END), '') AS mix_6_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_6_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_6_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_6_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_6_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_6_others_pct,

    -- RANK 7
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN name END), '') AS mix_7_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_7_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_7_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_7_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_7_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_7_others_pct,

    -- RANK 8
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN name END), '') AS mix_8_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_8_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_8_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_8_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_8_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_8_others_pct,

    -- RANK 9
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN name END), '') AS mix_9_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_9_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_9_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_9_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_9_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_9_others_pct,

    -- RANK 10
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN name END), '') AS mix_10_name,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS mix_10_payout,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN pct END), 0.0) AS mix_10_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN prospera_pct END), 0) AS mix_10_prospera_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN renasight_pct END), 0) AS mix_10_renasight_pct,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN others_pct END), 0) AS mix_10_others_pct

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name, 
        payout,
        CAST(CASE WHEN Max(payout) Over () = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (payout * 100.0 / Max(payout) Over ()) END AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS pct,
        CAST(CASE WHEN payout = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (prospera_payout * 100.0 / payout) END AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS prospera_pct,
        CAST(CASE WHEN payout = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (renasight_payout * 100.0 / payout) END AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS renasight_pct,
        CAST(CASE WHEN payout = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (others_payout * 100.0 / payout) END AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS others_pct,
        Row_Number() Over (Order By payout Desc) as rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SubString(p.participant_name, 0, IndexOf(p.participant_name, '(')) AS name, 
            SUM(p.amount) AS payout,
            SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Prospera' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS prospera_payout,
            SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Renasight' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS renasight_payout,
            SUM(CASE WHEN Coalesce(m.sub_category, tm.sub_category) = 'Others' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS others_payout
        FROM xactly.xc_payment p
        INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_paticipant_title_mapping pta
            ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_paticipant_territory_mapping ter
            ON p.participant_id = ter.master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN $framework.NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
            ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
            AND pta.title_name = m.title
        LEFT JOIN $framework.NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING tm 
            ON ter.territory = tm.territory 
            
        WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
          AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
          AND m.category = 'OH'
        GROUP BY 
            p.participant_name
    ) AggregatedData
) RankedData
WHERE rank <= 10;
